segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Call Center, this is Ava. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I think I need to cancel my follow-up appointment. I cannot keep missing work.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand. Missing work is stressful. Can I ask what time windows are easiest for you?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Early morning might work, but I am not sure the appointment is even worth it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Your follow-up helps the care team catch issues early. I can look for an earlier slot and confirm transportation options.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: If you can find something before work, I would probably keep it.
